ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Adds a new write-scoped job (traceability-manifest-regen-pr: contents:write + pull-requests:write) that opens/refreshes a bot PR carrying nothing but a regenerated .shipwright/compliance/test-traceability.json. Split from the pre-existing read-only traceability-manifest job (doubt-review, 2026-09-08) so the write scopes never coexist with the pinned third-party checkout in one job. Uses only the default GITHUB_TOKEN (no new secret/PAT), never attempts to merge, force-pushes with --force-with-lease (not bare --force), carries its own concurrency group, and does not touch the main-protection ruleset or any other job's permissions.
